method: MiroFish-inspired five-stage workflow; locally generated deterministic scenario artifacts
engine_limit: Not the MiroFish runtime. No external LLM, OASIS, Zep, or network call is used.

scenario.audience: Model UN delegates in India, 14 to 22, English-medium, preparing for a specific conference date
scenario.question: How might India-based Model UN delegates react to the current MUN Prep workspace, its 3-day no-card trial, and ₹199 weekly / ₹299 monthly passes?
scenario.snapshot: Public product surface and pricing plan, as of 2026-10-15
product_capabilities: Committee research and country policy preparation
scenario.evidence_boundary: The source personas and prior answers are synthetic founder-panel material. The replay is a rule-based scenario, not a human study, a demand forecast, or a live MiroFish/OASIS/LLM run.

entity_types.name: Delegate
entity_types.description: Synthetic Model UN delegate persona in the existing panel.

entity_types.name: MUNPrepApp
entity_types.description: The public MUN Prep product surface being explored.

entity_types.name: PreparationArtifact
entity_types.description: A research, writing, or debate-preparation output.

entity_types.name: Offer
entity_types.description: Trial and paid access terms visible to a delegate.

entity_types.name: TrustSignal
entity_types.description: A checkable proof point that can change perceived risk.

entity_types.name: Concern
entity_types.description: A stated friction or objection carried from the prior synthetic panel.

entity_types.name: Club
entity_types.description: A school or community that may influence group adoption.

entity_types.name: Conference
entity_types.description: The time-bound MUN event a delegate is preparing for.

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Fallback entity for a named synthetic agent.

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Fallback entity for a club, school, or product organization.

analysis_summary: Model how a 3-day no-card trial and MUN-specific workflow might change the conversation while keeping the synthetic-panel evidence boundary explicit. Focus on trial curiosity, trust/source proof, peer credibility, coach substitutes, and one-conference pricing.
